in_marathi.name: Jyotishee
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jyotishee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jyoti refers to 'light' and Ishvari means 'Goddess'. Therefore, Jyotishee is the Goddess of knowledge and wisdom. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of learning and arts.

in_bengali.name: Jyotishee
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Goddess of Knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jyotishee একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jyoti refers to 'light' and Ishvari means 'Goddess'. Therefore, Jyotishee is the Goddess of knowledge and wisdom. She is also known as Saraswati, the goddess of learning and arts.
